calls.video_title: ONE ETF Changes How You Invest for Income
calls.thesis: New Quantify Funds ETF (Income Q Nasdaq 100 Premium Income ETF) that gets Nasdaq 100 exposure via purchased in-the-money call options and generates income by selling puts/put spreads on individual stocks and the index, with weekly distributions. He likes selling puts instead of covered calls because it keeps upside uncapped — 'a better long-term bullish strategy than limiting your upside by selling calls' — and recommends considering it for investors who want tech growth plus recurring income (e.g. approaching retirement), as a diversifier, not as all of your money. Video is sponsored by Quantify Funds.
calls.base_case: Fund delivers Nasdaq 100 upside participation plus weekly income, outperforming covered-call income ETFs on total return over a full cycle.
calls.bull_case: Uncapped upside plus higher premiums from individual-stock puts beats covered-call funds; the put-selling approach proves a better long-term bullish income strategy.
calls.bear_case: In a tech correction the purchased calls lose value at the same time the short puts generate losses — larger declines than a traditional income fund; no track record to judge the strategy through different markets.
